claims.text: Advanced computational modeling and machine-learning algorithms can determine melting temperature, enthalpy and entropy of fusion, volume change upon melting, and liquid thermodynamic properties of high-entropy alloys.
The intervention is applicable to high-entropy alloys in high-temperature solid and liquid states.
Advanced computational modeling and machine learning will overcome limitations in the accuracy, availability, and efficiency of determining thermodynamic properties.
The intervention will improve accuracy and efficiency relative to current experimental and computational methods.
The intervention's performance is limited by the complexity of high-entropy alloys and of the computational models.
